scene_sentences: Prepare ingredients for Fresh Frozen Cucumbers: cucumber, salt, white sugar, distilled white vinegar.
Step 1 of Fresh Frozen Cucumbers: Place cucumbers into a large bowl and sprinkle with salt. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours..

Step 2 of Fresh Frozen Cucumbers: Rinse and drain cucumbers, pressing out as much water as possible. Place cucumbers back into the bowl and stir in sugar and vinegar until well combined. Cover and refrigerate for 24 more hours. Transfer to a freezer container and freeze..
